docs.title: 📖 LlamaCraft Official Player Wiki & Survival Manual
docs.text: Welcome to the definitive, forensic player guide for LlamaCraft! Everything here is reverse-engineered directly from the live server configurations and customized mechanics.

docs.title: 1. 🎣 Fishing, Spawners & Mob Drops
docs.text:
• Topics Covered:
  • /warp siyonocean environmental deep cold ocean fishing grounds.
  • Fish rarity tiers (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary) & size valuation formulas.
  • Custom bait catalog (Stringy Worms, Shrimps, Fresh Water, Epic Elixir, Legendary Lure, Infinite Bait).

docs.title: 💰 LlamaCraft Player Guide: Economy, Jobs & Player Trade
docs.text: Welcome to the definitive economy and commerce handbook for LlamaCraft. Learn how to maximize your hourly earnings through Jobs, navigate market shops, avoid the peer-to-peer transfer tax, and trade securely across the server.

docs.title: 🗺️ Quick Navigation & Economy Commands
docs.text: Command Action / Purpose /bal (or /balance) View your current Vault money balance. /baltop View the richest players on the server. /jobs (or /jobs menu) Open the Jobs graphical browser to join, leave, or view stats. /jobs browse View detailed payout tables for all 12 professions. /jobs shop Spend your earned Job Points on tools, enchantments, and Elytras. /shop Open the server commodity market to buy and sell raw materials. /sell (or /sellgui) Open the graphical sell chest to deposit and liquidate surplus items. /sellall Instantly sell all items in your inventory that exist in the shop. /ah (or /auctionhouse) Open the global player-to-player Auction House. /ah sell <price> List the item currently in your hand on the Auction House for 48 hours. /orders (or /market) Browse and fulfill active player buy-orders. /withdraw <amount> Convert digital balance into physical Banknotes ($0\% tax). /deposit Deposit held physical Banknotes back into your account balance. /pay <player> <amount> Send money to another player (Warning: 20% receiver tax applies!).

docs.title: 🏦 1. Getting Started: Currency & Physical Banknotes
docs.text:
• Starting Balance: Every new player joins LlamaCraft with \$1,000.00.
  • Physical Banknotes (/withdraw & /deposit):
  • Prefer physical cash over digital bank transfers? You can convert your money into physical Banknote items at zero fee and zero tax!
  • Commands:
    • /withdraw <amount>: Issues a signed Banknote in your inventory.
    • Right-Click the note to redeem it back into your balance.
    • Shift + Right-Click to deposit an entire stack of notes at once.
    • Sneak + Left-Click to split note denominations.

docs.title: ⚒️ 2. The Jobs System (/jobs)
docs.text: The primary engine for steady income on LlamaCraft is the Jobs system. Players can join up to 3 jobs simultaneously (max-jobs: 3).

docs.title: 📈 Exponential Progression & Level Scaling
docs.text:
Jobs are capped at Level 200. Unlike servers with flat payouts, LlamaCraft uses an exponential income progression formula:

$$\text{Income} = \text{Base Payout} \times 1.05^{\text{JobLevel} - 1}$$

  • Every level increases your job earnings by 5% compounded!
  • A Level 50 Miner earns over $10\times$ the base rate per block mined.
  • Holding multiple jobs incurs a negligible $5\%$ multi-job penalty, making 3 active jobs vastly superior to 1.

docs.title: 🛡️ Anti-Exploit Rules to Know:
docs.text:
1. Near-Spawner Mob Kills: Mobs that spawn from monster spawners do NOT pay job income. (Spawner farming earns money via physical mob drops sold at /shop, not job wages).
  2. Re-Placing Ores: Placing previously mined ores deducts money and XP (e.g., placing Diamond Ore costs $-\$10.00$). Silk-touch re-mining exploits are strictly blocked.

docs.title: 🌟 3. Job Points & The Rewards Shop (/jobs shop)
docs.text:
Every action that grants job money also awards Job Points. Job points are a permanent secondary currency that you can spend in the exclusive Job Shop (/jobs shop):

  • Super Pickaxe (10,000 Points + \$10,000): Diamond Pickaxe with Efficiency V, Unbreaking III, Jump Boost Potion, and an apple! (Requires Miner 50, Woodcutter 10, Total Level 100).
  • Lure III Enchanted Book (100 Points): Grants Lure III for fishing rods. (Requires Fisherman 100).
  • Angel Wings / Elytra (100,000 Points): Authentic Elytra redeemable directly through dedication to your craft!

docs.title: /shop (Server Commodity Market)
docs.text: Buy building materials, redstone, food, armor, and farming seeds, or sell bulk crops and mob drops directly to the server.

docs.title: /sellgui (The Graphical Selling Chest)
docs.text:
Typing /sell or /sellgui opens a dedicated selling container: 1. Drop any sellable items, surplus mob loot, or farm yields into the container. 2. Click the green confirm button. 3. The server computes the highest market price for all matching items and credits your balance in one click!

[!TIP] Quick Selling: Type /sellall to instantly sell all matching items in your inventory without opening the menu.

docs.title: 🏛️ 5. Player-to-Player Trade & The Auction House (/ah)
docs.text:
Want to trade custom gear, enchanted armor, shulker boxes, or rare fish with other players?

  • The Auction House (/ah):
  • Open the global market to browse, purchase, or list items.
  • Listing an Item: Hold the item and run /ah sell <price> (e.g. /ah sell 5000).
  • Limits: Every player can list up to 5 items simultaneously.
  • Duration: Listings stay active for 48 hours before expiring to your collection bin.

  • Shulker Box Previews: Hovering over a listed Shulker Box reveals its entire contents directly in the menu!

  • Market Orders (/orders):

  • Looking to buy specific building materials or mob drops in bulk?
  • Use /orders to place a public buy-order with your desired price. Other players can fulfill your order and receive instant payment.
  • Active orders remain open for 7 days with 0% market tax.

docs.title: ⚠️ 6. Direct Player Transfers & The 20% Tax (/pay)
docs.text:
[!WARNING] BEWARE OF THE 20% TRANSFER TAX ON /pay!

LlamaCraft runs a server economy money-sink on direct player-to-player transfers: 1. When you run /pay <player> <amount>, the sender pays the exact amount. 2. The receiver initially sees the full sum credited to their account. 3. Exactly 2 seconds later, a 20% server tax is automatically deducted from the receiver's balance with a tax notification: - Example: If you send someone \$100,000, the server will tax away \$20,000, leaving them with \$80,000!

docs.title: 💡 Pro-Tip: How to Trade with 0% Tax!
docs.text: If you are buying or selling items from another player in person, DO NOT USE /pay! Instead: 1. Run /withdraw <amount> to convert your cash into physical Banknotes ($0\%$ fee). 2. Drop or hand the physical Banknote directly to the player. 3. The recipient deposits the banknote with /deposit with ZERO TAX DEDUCTION!

docs.title: LlamaCraft Player Guide: Fishing, Spawners & Mob Drops
docs.text: Welcome to the definitive gathering guide for LlamaCraft. Whether you are an angler looking to reel in mythical sea creatures, a farmer automating crops, or an industrialist building 30,000-stack mob farms, this guide explains every mechanic, command, and optimal strategy.

docs.title: Quick Navigation & Core Commands
docs.text: Command Action / Purpose /warp siyonocean Teleport to the infinite Deep Cold Ocean fishing realm. /spawners (or /fishbarter) Open the Deep Sea Spawner Merchant to exchange custom fish for Spawners. /emf shop Open the fish market to sell your catches for Vault currency. /emf sellall Instantly sell all custom fish in your inventory for cash. /emf journal Browse your personal fishing logbook and caught species records. /emf applybaits Open the bait applicator to socket lures onto your fishing rod. /shop Open the server commodity market (sell mob drops, crops, and mob parts).

docs.title: 1. Multi-Dimensional Fishing Ecosystem
docs.text: Fishing on LlamaCraft is completely overhauled with EvenMoreFish and custom dimension fishing. Every cast hooks custom species categorized across 5 primary tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Junk.

docs.text:

$$\text{Payout} = \text{Length (cm)} \times \text{Rarity Multiplier}$$

docs.title: How to Apply Baits
docs.text:
1. Hold your fishing rod and type /emf applybaits (or drag and drop the bait item directly onto your fishing rod inside your inventory).
  2. Socket your desired bait into an available slot.
  3. Once equipped, bait slots appear in your rod's lore description.

docs.title: 4. Smart Spawner Automation & Upgraded Limits
docs.text:
Spawners on LlamaCraft feature an upgraded high-capacity automation engine:

  • Internal Storage: Smart Spawners hold up to 3 storage pages (135 item slots) and up to 30,000 stored EXP.
  • Massive Stacking: Hold identical spawners and Shift + Right-Click a placed spawner to stack up to 30,000 spawners into a single block.
  • Rapid Generation: Spawners cycle every 5 seconds (upgraded from 27s), generating 1 to 3 mob yields per cycle.
  • Mending Support: Spawners automatically repair items enchanted with Mending using the spawner's stored EXP reserve.
  • Proximity Range: Spawners activate whenever any player is within 16 blocks.
  • Explosion Immunity: Placed spawners are immune to TNT and Creeper blast destruction.
  • Hopper Automation: Hoppers collect up to 5 item stacks per second.

docs.title: How to Break & Move Spawners
docs.text:
• Silk Touch Requirement: Use an Iron, Golden, Diamond, or Netherite Pickaxe enchanted with Silk Touch I.
  • Mining consumes 50 tool durability.
  • Spawners go directly into your inventory.
  • Shift + Break: Break off up to 64 spawners from a massive stack at once.

docs.title: Natural Dungeon Spawners
docs.text: Natural spawners found in dungeons and fortresses can be mined with Silk Touch. They have a 60% chance to convert directly into a Smart Spawner item when broken.

docs.title: 5. Instant Crop Harvesting (Harvester)
docs.text: Farming crops is streamlined on LlamaCraft: * One-Click Harvest: Hold any Hoe and Right-Click fully grown wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, or nether wart. * Zero Durability Loss: Right-click harvesting does not consume hoe durability. * Instant Auto-Replant: Mature crops drop their yield and automatically replant seeds instantly.

docs.title: 📜 LlamaCraft Player Guide: Quests, Bounties & The Dragon Egg Relic
docs.text: Welcome to the epic adventures of LlamaCraft! Discover 1,000 tiered quests, claim player bounties, and hunt the elusive Dragon Egg in a server-wide King-of-the-Hill event.

docs.title: 🗺️ Quick Navigation & Quest Commands
docs.text: Command Action / Purpose /quests (or /quest, /q) Open the master Quest Journal to browse and accept missions. /quests abort Abandon an active quest you no longer wish to pursue. /bounties Open the active Wanted Posters board to view target players. /bounty <player> <amount> Place a monetary hit on a rival player ($0\% tax). /dragonegg (or /dragon) Check the current status, holder, and dimension of the Dragon Egg. /eventhub (or /events) Open the server community events and activities hub.

docs.title: 🎯 1. The 1,000 Quests Master Engine (/quests)
docs.text: LlamaCraft features a massive database of 1,000 custom quests organized across 10 gameplay categories. Quests range from beginner progression milestones to endgame trillion-dollar achievements!

docs.title: 🧪 2. Secret "Absurd" Quests & Environmental Physics
docs.text: LlamaCraft features custom environmental physics objectives that you won't find in standard Minecraft: * The Item Sacrifice: Destroying diamonds, netherite, or ancient debris in Cacti, Lava, Void, or Fire triggers hidden quest conditions! * Anvil Execution: Dropping an anvil from high above to crush hostile mobs completes specialized combat challenges. * Void Gliding: Flying with an Elytra below $Y=0$ in the End dimension triggers the End Void Glide achievement!

docs.title: 🤠 3. Player Headhunting & Bounties (/bounties)
docs.text:
Have a rival clan member or a player who stole your loot? Place a public bounty on their head!

  • Placing a Bounty: Run /bounty <player> <amount> (e.g. /bounty Steve 50000).
  • Zero Bounty Tax: Setting bounties carries 0% tax—the entire amount goes directly to whoever claims the kill.
  • The Wanted Board (/bounties): Browse live bounties, target headshots, and reward values.
  • Claiming the Reward: Slay the target in any PvP-enabled zone (Wilderness, /warp pvp) to immediately claim the cash!

docs.title: 🐉 4. The Server Relic: Dragon Egg Hunt (/dragonegg)
docs.text:
The Dragon Egg is not a static trophy on LlamaCraft—it is an active, persistent server-wide Relic with a permanent bounty on whoever holds it!

                  ✦ THE DRAGON EGG RELIC PROTOCOL ✦
   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   │ • Ender Chest Immunity: BLOCKED (Cannot be stashed in /ec)  │
   │ • Container Blacklist:  BLOCKED (No Shulkers, Hoppers, etc) │
   │ • Void Rescue:          ENABLED (Teleports to safe ground)  │
   │ • Global Tracker:       Compass points directly to owner!   │
   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: Rules of the Relic:
docs.text:
1. No Hiding in Enderchests: The plugin strictly forbids placing the Dragon Egg inside Ender Chests (/ec).
  2. No Storage Vaults: The Egg cannot be locked inside Shulker Boxes, Hoppers, Droppers, or Dispensers. It must remain in a player's active inventory or placed visibly as a block.
  3. Void Protection: If a carrier jumps into the void, the Egg will NOT be lost—it automatically rescues itself to a safe Y-level coordinate broadcast in chat!
  4. The Dragon Compass: Players can craft a specialized Tracker Compass that locks onto the current Egg holder's location in real-time.
  5. Global Broadcast: Whenever the Egg changes hands, a server-wide announcement notifies all players!

docs.title: 👑 LlamaCraft Player Guide: Ranks, Progression & Player Perks
docs.text: Level up from humble Stone wanderer to the Godlike Netherite sovereign! Learn how to rank up using in-game cash, expand your claimed territory, claim weekly rank kits, and unlock game-changing perks like fly mode and spawner harvesting.

docs.title: 🗺️ Quick Navigation & Rank Commands
docs.text: Command Action / Purpose /rankup (or /pru) Purchase the next server rank if you meet the balance requirement. /maxrankup Automatically purchase as many consecutive ranks as your balance allows. /ranks (or /ranksmenu) View the graphical rank ladder, requirements, and unlocked perks. /kit (or /kits) Open the weekly kit selector to claim your rank's care package. /homes View all your saved home waypoints. /sethome <name> Save your current location as a named home. /fly Toggle creative flight on or off (Netherite Rank Only).

docs.title: 🪜 1. The Official Rankup Ladder
docs.text:
Every player starts at the Stone rank for free. Higher ranks are earned purely through in-game gameplay and economy—no pay-to-win real money required!

docs.title: 1. Reaching Iron Rank: The Spawner Miner (smartspawner.break)
docs.text: At Iron Rank, you unlock permission to break and collect Smart Spawners and natural dungeon spawners with a Silk Touch Pickaxe. If you are still at Stone or Copper rank, spawners will resist extraction!

docs.title: 2. Reaching Netherite Rank: Unrestricted Flight (/fly)
docs.text: Netherite is the summit of survival progression on LlamaCraft. Achieving Netherite permanently unlocks /fly, enabling seamless base construction, terraforming, and aerial navigation.

docs.title: 🛡️ LlamaCraft Player Guide: Worlds, Land Claims & PvP Combat
docs.text: Learn how to explore across all 7 server dimensions, protect your base with golden shovel claims, navigate the high-stakes PvP combat tag rules, and survive with the hybrid keep-inventory engine!

docs.title: 🗺️ Quick Navigation & Claim Commands
docs.text: Command Action / Purpose /rtp (or /wild) Randomly teleport into the Overworld ($500 - 9,800$ blocks out). /spawn (or /survspawn) Teleport to the main lobby or survival spawn point. /warp <name> Browse and warp to server locations (siyonocean, pvp). /claim Automatically create a claim centered around your location. /trust <player> Grant a friend full build and break permissions in your claim. /containertrust <player> Grant permission to open chests, hoppers, barrels, and machines. /accesstrust <player> Grant permission to use buttons, levers, doors, and /sethome. /untrust <player> Revoke all permissions from a player. /abandonclaim Delete your current claim and refund 100% of your claim blocks. /trapped Safely escape if you are locked inside someone else's territory. /pvp (or /pvptoggle) Check your PvP combat status. /combattag Check remaining seconds on your combat tag timer.

docs.title: 🌍 1. The 7 Active Server Dimensions
docs.text:

docs.title: 🚩 2. Protecting Your Territory (GriefPrevention)
docs.text: Never worry about griefers, thieves, or explosions ruining your hard work. Land claims provide 100% impenetrable protection.

docs.title: 📐 Claim Tools & Basic Dimensions
docs.text:
• Inspection Tool: Right-click any block with a Stick to see who owns the land and view boundary boundaries.
  • Claiming Tool: Equip a Golden Shovel and right-click two opposite corners of your desired property to lock the claim.
  • Chest Auto-Claim: Placing your very first chest automatically creates a free $4 \times 4$ starter claim centered on the chest!
  • Dimensions: Claims must be at least $5$ blocks wide and have a minimum area of $100$ blocks ($10 \times 10$).
  • Depth Protection: Claims automatically extend from your placement point all the way down to Bedrock!

docs.title: ⏳ Earning Claim Blocks & Inactivity Rules
docs.text:
• Hourly Accrual: Every active hour of playtime awards +100 Claim Blocks (up to 80,000 blocks maximum).
  • Rank Bonuses: Ranking up through /rankup awards up to +17,500 Bonus Claim Blocks!
  • 100% Refund: Running /abandonclaim refunds 100% of the claim blocks back into your available pool.
  • Inactivity Protection: If you take a break, your claims stay protected for 60 days. If you have earned over 10,000 total claim blocks or 5,000 bonus blocks from ranks, your claims NEVER expire!

docs.text:
Control exactly who can touch your base:

docs.title: ⚔️ 3. PvP Combat, Combat Logging & Keep-Inventory Rules
docs.text: LlamaCraft runs a unique Hybrid Keep-Inventory & Combat Engine designed to encourage fair PvE survival while keeping PvP fights thrilling:

docs.title: 💀 The Death Rules Matrix
docs.text:
Cause of Death Do You Keep Your Inventory? Do You Keep Your XP? Monsters & Mobs (Zombies, Creepers, Warden, Wither) ✅ 100% KEPT ✅ 100% KEPT Environmental Hazards (Lava, Fire, Drowning, Fall) ✅ 100% KEPT ✅ 100% KEPT /suicide Command ✅ 100% KEPT ✅ 100% KEPT Slayed by Another Player in PvP ❌ DROPS ON GROUND ❌ DROPS ON GROUND

[!NOTE] Safe Zones: Land claims are 100% immune to PvP damage (ProtectPlayersInLandClaims: true). You cannot be harmed by other players while standing inside a claim!

docs.title: 🚨 The 15-Second Combat Tag Protocol
docs.text:
When you deal or receive damage from another player in the wilderness: 1. You are locked in Combat Tag for 15 seconds. 2. An on-screen action bar and glowing outline indicate active combat. 3. Throwing an Ender Pearl or using a Wind Charge immediately refreshes your combat tag. 4. All Escape Commands Are Blocked: /home, /spawn, /tpa, and /warp are disabled during combat.

[!CAUTION] DO NOT COMBAT LOG!

If you disconnect or close your game while tagged: - You are instantly executed. - Your entire inventory, armor, and XP drop on the ground for your enemy to loot! - You suffer an immediate 25% balance penalty deducted from your bank! - A server-wide broadcast announces your cowardly exit to all online players!

docs.title: 📱 4. Crossplay & Bedrock Support (Geyser & Floodgate)
docs.text: LlamaCraft is fully crossplay-compatible: * Bedrock players join using the standard Bedrock IP and port. * Custom GUI menus automatically adjust for mobile touchscreens and console gamepads. * Bedrock player skins are rendered natively across Java clients via BedrockSkinRestorer.
